correctness.rationale: Independent continuous jitters encode uniform tie-breaking. Conditioning on the lower of the two high scores gives the stated three-bin integral. I independently rebuilt the full \(3^4\) exact score-vector sum and the integral in SymPy; they agree identically. Re-centering at \(h=p-(1-\delta)/2\) factors \(P(p)-P(\mathrm{center})\) exactly as \(\delta h^2G_\delta(h^2)/24\). The polynomial \(G_\delta\) decreases in \(u=h^2\) on the admissible interval, and its endpoint value \(7+110\delta+14\delta^2-2\delta^3-\delta^4\) is positive for \(0<\delta<1\), proving the unique minimum.
